hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */src/*|*/tests/*|*/packages/*) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; out=$(npm test 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | tail -40 1>&2; exit 2; } ;; esac

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *"git push"*) : ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; if printf ' %s ' "$cmd" | grep -qE '[^-A-Za-z0-9_]main[^-A-Za-z0-9_]'; then echo 'Blocked: direct push to main is forbidden (docs/development.md). Merge via PR instead.' 1>&2; exit 2; fi; br=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$br" = "main" ]; then echo 'Blocked: current branch is main; switch to a feat branch before pushing.' 1>&2; exit 2; fi
